def rectdist(p, cells):
    # min Chebyshev distance from point p to any cell of the rectangle (bbox)
    a,b=p
    rs=[r for r,_ in cells]; cs=[c for _,c in cells]

    return max(max(r0-a, a-r1, 0), max(c0-b, b-c1, 0))
